title: DP19840 Harmonization. . . What Else? The Role for International Regulatory Agreements
title_zh: 协调一致……还有何其他？国际监管协定的作用
title_primary: 协调一致……还有何其他？国际监管协定的作用
title_secondary: DP19840 Harmonization. . . What Else? The Role for International Regulatory Agreements
authors: Giovanni Maggi, Monika Mrazova
official: 官方在线 2025-01-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We examine the potential role of international agreements on product standards through a stylized model where countries have different regulatory preferences and firms incur fixed costs of regulatory diversity. Overall, our analysis suggests that the common perception of regulatory agreements as playing a key role in promoting harmonization may have been over- stated. We show that regulatory harmony can arise even in the absence of an agreement, and that “spontaneous” harmonization may be inefficient, suggesting that the role of regulatory agreements could be to promote regulatory diversity rather than harmonization. Moreover, the role of regulatory cooperation depends in important ways on the pattern of trade: in the presence of intra-industry trade, the potential role of an agreement tends to be more limited, and under some conditions it can only play a coordination role. Finally, through the lens of our model, we examine the “Pop Critique” of regulatory agreements, according to which lobbying by corporate interests may lead to welfare-reducing harmonization. Our analysis lends only limited support to this critique.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一个风格化模型探讨了国际产品标准协议可能发挥的作用，在该模型中，各国具有不同的监管偏好，而企业则需承担监管多样性的固定成本。总体而言，我们的分析表明，关于监管协议在促进协调统一方面发挥关键作用的普遍看法可能被夸大了。我们证明，即使在没有协议的情况下，监管和谐也可能出现，而“自发”的和谐可能效率低下，这表明监管协议的作用或许在于促进监管多样性而非统一。此外，监管合作的作用在很大程度上取决于贸易模式：在存在产业内贸易的情况下，协议潜在作用往往更为有限，并且在某些条件下，它只能发挥协调作用。最后，通过我们模型的视角，我们审视了针对监管协议的“大众批评”，该批评认为企业利益的游说可能导致福利降低的和谐化。我们的分析对此批评仅提供了有限的支持。

title: Preventing Information Leakage
title_zh: 防止信息泄露
title_primary: 防止信息泄露
title_secondary: Preventing Information Leakage
authors: Jonathan Brogaard, Dan Li, Matthew Ma, Ryan Riordan, Bart Zhou Yueshen
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Traders devote significant resources to producing private information. The value of such information is eroded when it is leaked. We study the use of multiple brokers by institutions to help mitigate information leakage. We document that trades using multiple brokers better predict future returns and have higher future profits, consistent with information possessed by investors driving the decision to use multiple brokers. We find that trades using multiple brokers are more informed and, yet, have lower price impacts, lower implementation shortfalls, and fewer follower trades than similar single-broker trades. The results suggest that traders use multiple brokers to successfully reduce information leakage. This paper was accepted by Camelia Kuhnen, finance. Supplemental Material: The internet appendix and data files are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00201 .
abstract_zh: 交易者投入大量资源以生成私有信息。此类信息的价值在泄露时便会受损。我们研究了机构使用多家经纪商以帮助减轻信息泄露的情况。我们记录到，使用多家经纪商的交易能更好地预测未来收益，并带来更高的未来利润，这与投资者所掌握的信息驱动其选择多家经纪商的决定相一致。我们发现，使用多家经纪商的交易更具信息含量，然而，与相似的单经纪商交易相比，其价格影响更低、执行缺口更小，且跟随交易者更少。这些结果表明，交易者利用多家经纪商成功减少了信息泄露。本文由Camelia Kuhnen（金融领域）接受。补充材料：网络附录及数据文件可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2025.00201 获取。

title: Is physician cost-sharing an alternative to patient cost-sharing?
title_zh: 医生费用分担能否替代患者费用分担？
title_primary: 医生费用分担能否替代患者费用分担？
title_secondary: Is physician cost-sharing an alternative to patient cost-sharing?
authors: Klein, Tobias, Salm, Martin, Klein, Tobias J.
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines whether financial incentives for general practitioners (GPs) can effectively replace patient cost-sharing within a gatekeeper healthcare system in which the GP regulates access to specialist care. We estimate the effects of incentives provided to GPs by exploiting a field experiment in which treated GPs received a share of the cost savings they achieved. There was also a set of control practices. The patient population includes about 26,000 individuals and is largely representative of the overall population in the Netherlands. We estimate the effects of incentives for patients provided by a deductible using a simulated instrumental variables approach. For both sets of analyses, we use the same measures of healthcare costs, the same time period, and the same population of patients. Our findings show that the incentives provided to GPs reduce costs by 4.3 percent, mainly by decreasing less-urgent specialist care. A small patient deductible of 375 euros per year reduces costs by 27.8 percent in each month in which patients still have to pay out-of-pocket and 10.4 percent at the annual level, impacting all types of care. In contrast, physicians discriminate by type and priority of care. We do not find clear patterns for the interaction of incentives provided to GPs and patients. Our results suggest that GP incentives may complement but not fully replace patient deductibles in managing healthcare costs effectively.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在守门人医疗体系中，全科医生（GPs）的财务激励能否有效替代患者费用分摊，其中全科医生负责调控专科医疗的准入。我们利用一项实地实验来估计对全科医生提供的激励效应，实验中受激励的全科医生可获得其实现的成本节约份额，同时设有对照组诊所。患者群体约包含26,000人，在很大程度上代表了荷兰总体人口。我们采用模拟工具变量方法，估计了由免赔额提供的患者激励效应。对于两组分析，我们使用了相同的医疗成本衡量指标、相同的时间段以及相同的患者群体。研究结果显示，对全科医生提供的激励使成本降低了4.3%，主要通过减少非紧急专科医疗服务实现。每年375欧元的小额患者免赔额在患者仍需自付费用的月份中每月降低成本27.8%，年度水平上降低10.4%，影响所有类型的医疗服务。相比之下，医生会根据护理类型和优先级进行区分。我们未发现全科医生与患者激励交互作用的明确模式。我们的结果表明，在有效管理医疗成本方面，全科医生激励可能补充但无法完全替代患者免赔额。

title: New Evidence on the US Excess Return on Foreign Portfolios
title_zh: 美国对外投资组合超额收益的新证据
title_primary: 美国对外投资组合超额收益的新证据
title_secondary: New Evidence on the US Excess Return on Foreign Portfolios
authors: Bertaut, Carol, Curcuru, Stephanie E., Faia, Ester, Gourinchas, Pierre-Olivier
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We provide new estimates of the return on US external claims and liabilities using confidential, high-quality, security-level data. The excess return is positive on average, since claims are relatively more tilted toward higher-return equities. The excess return is large and positive in normal times and large and negative during global crises, reflecting the global insurance role of the US external balance sheet. With an increased frequency of global crises, the excess return has declined over the recent period. When controlling for issuer's nationality, US investors have larger exposure to equity issued by Asia-headquartered corporations than reported in aggregate statistics. Equity portfolios are concentrated in 'superstar' firms, but for US liabilities foreign holdings are less concentrated than the overall market.
abstract_zh: 我们利用保密、高质量、证券层面的数据，对美国外部债权与负债的回报率提供了新的估计。平均而言，超额回报为正，因为债权相对更倾向于高回报的股权。在正常时期，超额回报大且为正，而在全球危机期间则大且为负，这反映了美国外部资产负债表的全球保险作用。随着全球危机频率的增加，近期超额回报有所下降。在控制发行人国籍后，美国投资者对总部位于亚洲的公司发行的股权敞口大于汇总统计数据所显示的水平。股权组合集中于“超级明星”企业，但对于美国负债而言，外国持有集中度低于整体市场。

title: Winning is Contagious: Social Learning and the Dynamics of Union Support
title_zh: 胜利具有传染性：社会学习与工会支持动态
title_primary: 胜利具有传染性：社会学习与工会支持动态
title_secondary: Winning is Contagious: Social Learning and the Dynamics of Union Support
authors: Ellora Derenoncourt, Arindrajit Dube, Suresh Naidu, Heather Sarsons, Niharika Singh
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Union growth has historically happened in spurts. We combine union election data from 1961–2025 with a large-scale information experiment involving 9,000 low-wage workers to study the role of social learning in union growth. Observationally, close election wins cause future wins within state-industries. Experimentally, information about recent union wins increases union support and beliefs about co-worker support, with effects concentrated among workers with weak information environments and low baseline coworker support. In contrast, information about labor market tightness has little effect. Our results highlight social learning as a mechanism for union growth.
abstract_zh: 工会增长在历史上呈现间歇性爆发。我们结合1961年至2025年的工会选举数据，以及一项涉及9000名低工资工人的大规模信息实验，研究社会学习在工会增长中的作用。从观察上看，接近的选举胜利会导致州行业内未来的胜利。实验上，关于近期工会胜利的信息增加了工会支持度及对同事支持的信念，其效应集中在信息环境薄弱和同事支持基线较低的工人中。相比之下，关于劳动力市场紧张的信息影响甚微。我们的结果凸显了社会学习作为工会增长的一种机制。

title_secondary:

authors: Xiaoping Zhang, Tao Zhao, Tianyu Wang, Rong Yuan, Liang Dong
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Prior studies have not fully examined the factors associated with the global CO 2 transfer network driven by information and communication technology (ICT) investments (GCNI). We employ a multi-regional input-output model, complex network analysis, and an exponential random graph model to explore the evolution and formation mechanisms of the GCNI between 2000 and 2020 from the perspective of foreign direct investment (FDI) motivations. The results indicate that the GCNI has become increasingly interconnected. CO 2 transfer relationships exhibit significant reciprocity and triadic closure characteristics. Larger and more open markets are more likely to receive CO 2 transfer relationships, while similar markets are more likely to establish such relationships. Vertical factors associated with receiving CO 2 transfer relationships evolve from abundant natural resources to low-cost labour, and eventually to highly skilled labour. Regions with stricter environmental regulations and higher corporate tax rates are more likely to initiate these relationships. Our findings suggest that FDI motivation-related factors are closely associated with the geographical pattern of ICT investment-driven emission transfers. These associations may be informative for investment-related emission disclosure, carbon accounting, and discussions of carbon responsibilities and sustainable ICT development in the digital era.
abstract_zh: 以往研究尚未充分探讨与信息和通信技术（ICT）投资驱动的全球二氧化碳转移网络（GCNI）相关的因素。我们采用多区域投入产出模型、复杂网络分析和指数随机图模型，从外国直接投资（FDI）动机的视角，探究2000年至2020年间GCNI的演化与形成机制。结果表明，GCNI的互联性日益增强。二氧化碳转移关系呈现出显著的互惠性和三元闭合特征。市场规模更大、开放程度更高的经济体更易成为二氧化碳转移关系的接收方，而相似的市场之间则更倾向于建立此类关系。与接收二氧化碳转移关系相关的垂直因素，从丰富的自然资源逐步演变为低成本劳动力，最终转向高技能劳动力。环境规制更严格、企业税率更高的地区更可能发起此类关系。我们的发现表明，与FDI动机相关的因素与ICT投资驱动的排放转移地理格局密切相关。这些关联可能为投资相关的排放披露、碳核算，以及数字时代碳责任与可持续ICT发展的讨论提供参考信息。

title: Majority Lost: Global Evidence and Field Experiments on Electoral Miscoordination
title_zh: 多数派失利：选举协调失灵的全球证据与实地实验
title_primary: 多数派失利：选举协调失灵的全球证据与实地实验
title_secondary: Majority Lost: Global Evidence and Field Experiments on Electoral Miscoordination
authors: Francesco Capozza, Ruben Durante, Siddharth Eapen George
official: 官方在线 2026-07-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Voters in multiparty systems often fail to coordinate on majority-preferred parties. Using constituency-level election data linked to party-ideology measures across 96 countries, we show that in 20–30% of multiparty elections since 1940 the Condorcet winner does not win, and in roughly 10% the winner is the Condorcet loser. Failures are most common under plurality rule and in fragmented, volatile party systems, and systematically disadvantage opposition and culturally liberal parties while benefiting organizationally strong ones. Can information fix this? In four pre-registered experiments around Indian elections (N > 4,000), constituency-level polls shift voting intentions by at most 2 percentage points, a precisely estimated null, despite modest belief updating, though undecided voters become 7 points more likely to support a viable party. A model with expressive motives rationalizes both results: polls refine beliefs but lack the leverage to overcome entrenched attachments, identifying boundary conditions on polls as coordination devices.
abstract_zh: 在多党制中，选民往往难以协调支持多数偏好的政党。通过将96个国家的选区级选举数据与政党意识形态指标相关联，我们发现自1940年以来，20%至30%的多党选举中孔多塞胜者未能获胜，约10%的选举中胜者实为孔多塞败者。此类失败在单一选区制、碎片化且不稳定的政党体系中最为常见，并系统性地不利于反对党及文化自由主义政党，而有利于组织力量强大的政党。信息能否解决这一问题？在围绕印度选举开展的四项预注册实验中（样本量>4000），选区级民调对投票意向的影响至多为2个百分点——这一精确估计的零效应，尽管存在适度的信念更新，但未决选民支持可行政党的概率提升了7个百分点。一个包含表达性动机的模型可同时解释这两项结果：民调虽能修正信念，却缺乏克服根深蒂固依附关系的杠杆作用，从而界定了民调作为协调机制的条件边界。

title: DP34 Aggregate Production Functions and Productivity Measurement: A New Look
title_zh: 总量生产函数与生产率测度：一个新视角
title_primary: 总量生产函数与生产率测度：一个新视角
title_secondary: DP34 Aggregate Production Functions and Productivity Measurement: A New Look
authors: John Muellbauer, Jeremy Bulow, Paul Klemperer, Lars Hendrik Röller, Robin Siekles
official: 官方在线 1984-11-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper presents theoretical arguments and empirical evidence from British manufacturing for the view that the first of these is the most serious with important dimensions in the measurement of capital and output as well as that of utilization. New light is shed on two classic questions. One was first raised by Feldstein (1967) who observed in a cross-section context that the elasticity of output w. r. t. average observed hours of work significantly exceeded the elasticity w. r. t. employment. Craine (1973) observed a similar result for time-series data. The other question is one with which most researchers on productivity have struggled: how to correct productivity for cyclical variations in the utlization of inputs. A novel answer based on the use of overtime hours data is found to give excellent empirical results.
abstract_zh: 本文从理论论证和英国制造业的经验证据出发，认为上述第一个问题最为严重，且在资本与产出的测度以及利用率维度上均具有重要影响。研究为两个经典问题提供了新视角。其一是由Feldstein（1967）首次提出，他在横截面分析中发现，产出相对于平均观测工时弹性显著高于相对于就业弹性；Craine（1973）在时间序列数据中也观察到类似结果。另一个问题是大多数生产率研究者长期面临的挑战：如何校正投入要素利用率周期性波动对生产率的影响。本文基于加班工时数据提出创新性解决方案，实证结果表现优异。

title: Location Choice and Price Discrimination in a Duopoly

title_primary: 双寡头市场中的选址决策与价格歧视

authors: Tommaso Valletti, Shota Ichihashi, Alex Smolin, Jamie Coen, Anil K Kashyap 等
official: 聚合元数据日期 2002-05-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper analyzes the problem of price discrimination in a market where consumers have heterogeneous preferences over both a horizontal parameter (brand) and a vertical one (quality). A model with two firms competing over locations and non-linear contracts is analyzed. Discriminatory contracts are first characterized at each location. It is then shown that locations have a big impact on the firms' discriminatory ability and that equilibrium locations are non-monotonic in consumer types; however firms never locate too far away from the first and third quartiles.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了消费者在水平参数（品牌）和垂直参数（质量）上均存在异质性偏好的市场中的价格歧视问题。研究构建了一个包含两家企业在区位与非线性合约上竞争的理论模型。首先刻画了各区位下的歧视性合约特征，进而证明区位对企业歧视能力具有显著影响，且均衡区位随消费者类型呈非单调变化；然而，企业从未将区位设定得远离第一与第三四分位数。

title: Beyond gold and Bitcoin: stochastic dominance evidence for Rolex watches as an elite safe-haven asset
title_zh: 超越黄金与比特币：劳力士手表作为精英避险资产的随机占优证据
title_primary: 超越黄金与比特币：劳力士手表作为精英避险资产的随机占优证据
title_secondary: Beyond gold and Bitcoin: stochastic dominance evidence for Rolex watches as an elite safe-haven asset
authors: Ahmad Bash, Ibraheem Alaskar, Reyadh Faras, Nour Alshamali, Abdullah M. Al-Awadhi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-22 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates whether luxury watches offer diversification benefits as alternative investment assets. Using the stochastic dominance method, we aim to provide robust statistical evidence of the safe-haven properties of Rolex watches. Our analysis shows that for risk-averse investors, the Rolex index stochastically dominates traditional alternatives, including gold, Bitcoin, and equities. This dominance is primarily driven by superior price stability, extreme positive skewness, and limited downside risk, rather than simply the mean return. We identify an optimal portfolio allocation consisting of 65–70% Rolex watches and the remainder in gold. This diversified strategy yields a superior risk-return profile, lies on the efficient frontier, and achieves first-order stochastic dominance over a pure Rolex position. This research contributes to the literature by extending the stochastic dominance framework to physical luxury collectables for the first time and highlighting the critical role of distributional properties, such as low tail risk and positive skewness, in determining asset dominance.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨奢侈品手表作为另类投资资产是否具备分散化投资优势。通过随机占优方法，我们旨在为劳力士手表的避险属性提供稳健的统计证据。分析表明，对于风险厌恶型投资者而言，劳力士指数在随机占优意义上优于黄金、比特币及股票等传统替代资产。这种优势主要源于其卓越的价格稳定性、极端正偏态分布特征以及有限的下行风险，而非单纯的平均收益率差异。我们识别出由65%-70%劳力士手表与剩余黄金构成的最优投资组合配置。该分散化策略呈现出更优的风险收益特征，位于有效前沿曲线上，并实现对纯劳力士头寸的一阶随机占优。本研究首次将随机占优框架拓展至实体奢侈品收藏品领域，揭示了低尾部风险与正偏态等分布特征在决定资产占优性中的关键作用，为相关文献作出贡献。

title: The Well-Being Costs of Low Emission Zones: Evidence from London's ULEZ Expansions
title_zh: 低排放区的福利成本：来自伦敦ULEZ扩展的证据
title_primary: 低排放区的福利成本：来自伦敦ULEZ扩展的证据
title_secondary: The Well-Being Costs of Low Emission Zones: Evidence from London's ULEZ Expansions
authors: Corin Blanc
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In response to rising urban air pollution, European cities have adopted Low Emission Zones (LEZs), restricting the most polluting vehicles. While effective in improving air quality, these policies remain controversial due to concerns over fairness and acceptability. This paper examines the impact of London’s 2021 and 2023 Ultra Low Emission Zone (ULEZ) expansions on Subjective Well-Being (SWB). Using panel data from the UK Household Longitudinal Study and a staggered difference-in-differences design with individual and year fixed effects, we compare changes in life satisfaction among residents inside and outside the affected areas. We find that the 2021 expansion led to a decline in life satisfaction by approximately 0.4 points. We explore the mechanisms driving this decline and find that the well-being loss is mediated by car dependency and transport mode availability. While the policy increased reliance on public transport, we show that a better accessibility to public transport mitigates the decline in life satisfaction among London residents. Furthermore, we show that the well-being costs of the policy are regressive, disproportionately affecting lower-income households. These findings suggest that LEZs can generate short-term and unequal well-being costs despite achieving modest behavioural change, highlighting the need for complementary measures to enhance social acceptability.
abstract_zh: 针对城市空气污染日益加剧的问题，欧洲城市采取了低排放区（LEZs）措施，限制高污染车辆的使用。尽管这些政策在改善空气质量方面成效显著，但因其公平性与可接受性方面的担忧而备受争议。本文考察了伦敦2021年及2023年超低排放区（ULEZ）扩展对主观幸福感（SWB）的影响。利用英国家庭纵向研究的面板数据，并采用包含个体及年份固定效应的交错双重差分设计，我们比较了受影响区域内外居民生活满意度的变化。研究发现，2021年的扩展导致生活满意度下降约0.4个百分点。我们进一步探究了这一下降背后的机制，发现幸福感损失受汽车依赖度及交通方式可用性的中介作用影响。尽管政策增加了对公共交通的依赖，但研究表明，更好的公共交通可达性能够缓解伦敦居民生活满意度的下降。此外，我们还发现该政策的幸福感成本具有累退性，对低收入家庭的影响尤为显著。这些发现表明，低排放区在实现适度行为改变的同时，可能产生短期且不平等的幸福感成本，凸显了采取补充措施以增强社会可接受性的必要性。

title: The Price of Political Ties: Reputational Risk and the Strategic Divestment of Corporate PACs
title_zh: 政治关系的代价：声誉风险与企业政治行动委员会的战略性剥离
title_primary: 政治关系的代价：声誉风险与企业政治行动委员会的战略性剥离
title_secondary: The Price of Political Ties: Reputational Risk and the Strategic Divestment of Corporate PACs
authors: Eric A. Baldwin, Takuma Iwasaki, John J. Donohue, Charlie Grabois
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Political contributions generate access and influence for firms, but their public visibility exposes firms to reputational risk. We study how firms adjust their political spending when the reputational cost of political ties rises sharply. To identify this response, we exploit fatal school shootings and mass shootings as exogenous shocks to the salience of gun violence in the United States. We implement a staggered difference-in-differences design on a panel of corporate PAC contributions to U.S. House candidates, 2000–2024. We find that corporate PACs divest selectively and temporarily following gun violence shocks. Contributions to Republican candidates fall by 70.3% after fatal school shootings in competitive districts and return to baseline within nine months, with no substitution toward Democratic candidates. A parallel penalty of 60.9% emerges for Republicans in safe Democratic districts but is absent in safe Republican districts. Mass shootings generate similar perturbations in corporate contributions. These patterns indicate that firms withdraw only where the reputational risk of continued association is high or its strategic value is low. The observed divestment appears across industries and is stronger for firms with greater consumer exposure. Our findings reveal that firms treat political ties as time-varying liabilities, temporarily withdrawing visible financial support when issue salience spikes and resuming once public attention fades, leaving firms’ long-run political investment intact. Since public pressure is limited and dissipates quickly, and corporate divestment is transient rather than durably reallocated, the underlying financial incentives facing policymakers remain unchanged in the long run, sustaining the policy status quo.
abstract_zh: 政治献金为企业带来准入渠道和影响力，但其公开性也使企业面临声誉风险。本文研究当政治关联的声誉成本急剧上升时，企业如何调整其政治支出。为识别这一反应，我们利用美国校园枪击案和大规模枪击案作为枪支暴力议题显著性的外生冲击。基于2000-2024年企业政治行动委员会（PAC）对众议院候选人捐款的面板数据，我们采用交错双重差分法进行分析。研究发现，在枪支暴力冲击后，企业PAC会进行选择性且暂时性的撤资：在竞争性选区，致命校园枪击事件后企业对共和党候选人的捐款下降70.3%，并在九个月内恢复至基准水平，且未出现向民主党候选人的替代性转移；在民主党安全选区，共和党候选人面临60.9%的平行惩罚，但在共和党安全选区则无此效应。大规模枪击案同样引发企业捐款的类似波动。这些模式表明，企业仅会在持续关联的声誉风险较高或战略价值较低的领域撤资。观察到的撤资现象跨行业存在，且对消费者曝光度更高的企业更为显著。研究揭示，企业将政治关联视为时变负债——当议题显著性飙升时暂时撤回显性财务支持，待公众关注消退后恢复，从而保持长期政治投资不变。由于公众压力有限且快速消散，企业撤资具有暂时性而非持久性再分配特征，政策制定者面临的潜在财务激励长期未变，最终维持了政策现状。

title: DP52 On Two Aspects of Post-War Irish Emigration
title_zh: 论战后爱尔兰移民的两个方面
title_primary: 论战后爱尔兰移民的两个方面
title_secondary: DP52 On Two Aspects of Post-War Irish Emigration
authors: Cormac Ó Gráda
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Much of the controversy about labour migration concerns an aspect which is not easily measured, the 'quality' of the flow. The first part of the paper applies logit analysis to a sample of emigrants from an Irish border county for some insight on the issue. The results suggest that while those who leave are relatively better educated than their neighbours, kinship variables such as parental attitudes and emigrant sponsors, are also important. The second part of the paper weighs 'life-cycle' losses from post-war Irish migration against receipts from emigrant tourism and remittances. It turns out that these items make a big dent in the losses.
abstract_zh: 关于劳动力迁移的诸多争议集中于一个难以衡量的方面，即迁移流的“质量”。论文第一部分运用逻辑回归分析，对来自爱尔兰边境郡的移民样本进行考察，以探究该问题。结果表明，尽管离境者相较于其邻人受教育程度更高，但亲属关系变量（如父母态度与移民担保人）同样具有重要影响。第二部分则权衡了战后爱尔兰移民的“生命周期”损失与移民旅游及汇款收入。结果显示，这些收入显著抵消了部分损失。

title: The Last Taxi: LCR Buffers and Bank Liquidity Provision
title_zh: 最后的出租车：流动性覆盖率缓冲与银行流动性供给
title_primary: 最后的出租车：流动性覆盖率缓冲与银行流动性供给
title_secondary: The Last Taxi: LCR Buffers and Bank Liquidity Provision
authors: Matt Darst, Lucia Gurrieri, Arazi Lubis, Alexandros Vardoulakis
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-31 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines whether regulatory liquidity buffers enable banks to support corporate borrowers during financial stress. Using confidential bank-firm credit data and hand-collected Liquidity Coverage Ratio regulation (LCR) disclosures during COVID-19, we find that banks with higher LCR buffers above the regulatory minimum provided significantly more credit to firms with large undrawn credit lines in March 2020. Critically, only buffers, not overall LCR levels, matter, revealing that the regulatory minimum operates as a binding constraint during stress. The effect is concentrated among high-quality borrowers with clean credit profiles and disappears by mid-2020, confirming that LCR buffers provide selective, temporary liquidity insurance during acute stress.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了监管流动性缓冲是否能使银行在金融压力时期为企业借款人提供支持。利用新冠疫情期间的机密银行-企业信贷数据及手工收集的流动性覆盖率（LCR）监管披露信息，我们发现，在2020年3月，LCR缓冲高于监管最低要求的银行，向拥有大量未提取信贷额度的企业提供了显著更多的信贷。关键在于，只有缓冲水平而非整体LCR水平产生影响，这表明监管最低要求在压力时期构成了具有约束力的限制。这一效应集中于信用记录良好的高质量借款人，并在2020年年中消失，证实了LCR缓冲在严重压力时期提供了选择性、临时性的流动性保险。

title: Taxing Top Incomes in the Emerging World—Fiscal and Economic Impact under the Microscope
title_zh: 新兴世界中的高收入征税——财政与经济影响的微观审视
title_primary: 新兴世界中的高收入征税——财政与经济影响的微观审视
title_secondary: Taxing Top Incomes in the Emerging World—Fiscal and Economic Impact under the Microscope
authors: Axelson, Christopher, Hohmann, Antonia, Pirttilä, Jukka, Raabe, Roxanne, Riedel, Nadine
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper studies taxpayer responses to an increase in the top marginal tax rate in South Africa, drawing on rich administrative data and a transparent identification strategy. We show that treated taxpayers strongly reduced their reported taxable income in response to the reform, with adjustments along a broad range of taxable income components. While tax evasion and avoidance explain a sizable share of this response, there is also indication for reduced work effort and business performance of South African corporations led by treated taxpayers—suggesting that raising taxes on top incomes may entail broader economic repercussions.
abstract_zh: 本文利用丰富的行政数据和透明的识别策略，研究了南非最高边际税率上调后纳税人的反应。我们发现，受影响的纳税人显著减少了其申报的应税收入，调整涉及应税收入的多个组成部分。尽管逃税和避税行为在很大程度上解释了这一反应，但也有迹象表明，受影响的纳税人所领导的南非企业的工作努力程度和经营业绩有所下降——这表明对高收入群体增税可能带来更广泛的经济影响。

title: Unintended effects of gender quotas on task assignment and firm performance
title_zh: 性别配额对任务分配和企业绩效的非预期影响
title_primary: 性别配额对任务分配和企业绩效的非预期影响
title_secondary: Unintended effects of gender quotas on task assignment and firm performance
authors: José J. Domínguez, Natalia Montinari
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine the unintended effects of gender‐based hiring quotas on task allocation and organizational performance using a controlled laboratory experiment designed to mirror team formation and delegation decisions. Participants in the role of employers selected workers and assigned them to either simple or challenging tasks, where performance determined firm earnings. In the absence of quotas, high‐ability women were less likely than their male counterparts to be hired or assigned to high‐responsibility tasks. Imposing a 50% gender quota increased overall female representation and their access to complex tasks, but did not improve outcomes for high‐performing women, who remain relatively less likely to be assigned to high‐responsibility tasks compared to comparable men. Moreover, firm performance declined under the quota due to weaker alignment between worker ability and task assignment. These findings suggest that while quotas enhance representational equity, they may unintentionally reduce efficiency when organizational processes fail to support merit‐based allocation—offering important implications for the design of equity‐enhancing labour market policies.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项受控实验室实验，研究了基于性别的招聘配额对任务分配和组织绩效的非预期影响。该实验旨在模拟团队组建和授权决策。扮演雇主的参与者选择工人，并将其分配到简单或具有挑战性的任务中，任务表现决定企业收益。在没有配额的情况下，高能力女性被雇佣或分配到高责任任务的可能性低于同等能力的男性。实施50%的性别配额提高了女性的整体代表性及其接触复杂任务的机会，但并未改善高绩效女性的结果——与同等能力的男性相比，她们被分配到高责任任务的可能性仍然相对较低。此外，由于工人能力与任务分配之间的匹配度减弱，配额下的企业绩效出现下降。这些发现表明，虽然配额增强了代表性公平，但当组织流程未能支持基于能力的分配时，它们可能无意中降低效率——这对设计促进公平的劳动力市场政策具有重要启示。

title: Ned Phelps and modern macroeconomics
title_zh: 内德·菲尔普斯与现代宏观经济学
title_primary: 内德·菲尔普斯与现代宏观经济学
title_secondary: Ned Phelps and modern macroeconomics
authors: Peter Howitt
official: 官方在线 2026-07-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The macroeconomic theory that is taught in graduate schools, and used in the conduct of monetary and fiscal policy around the world today, emerged from a revolution in economics that was led by Ned Phelps. This column discusses Phelps’s theoretical contributions and how they created a micro foundation for macroeconomics.
abstract_zh: 如今研究生院教授并被全球用于货币与财政政策制定的宏观经济理论，源于由内德·菲尔普斯引领的经济学革命。本文探讨了菲尔普斯的理论贡献，以及这些贡献如何为宏观经济学奠定了微观基础。

title: Measuring the Value of Disability Insurance from Take-Up Decisions
title_zh: 从参保决策衡量伤残保险的价值
title_primary: 从参保决策衡量伤残保险的价值
title_secondary: Measuring the Value of Disability Insurance from Take-Up Decisions
authors: Andreas Haller, Stefan Staubli
official: 官方在线月份 2026-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The central trade-off for designing Disability Insurance (DI) is between providing insurance to those in need while maintaining incentives to work. This paper develops a novel revealed-preference approach to identify the insurance value of DI benefits. We show that comparing the DI take-up response to a change in benefits versus a change in wages identifies the insurance value. Implementing our framework in Canada, we estimate that increasing DI benefits by $1 creates an additional disincentive cost of $0.60 but creates an insurance value of $2.20. Thus, our approach suggests that DI benefits are not overly generous in the Canadian context.
abstract_zh: 设计残疾保险（DI）的核心权衡在于：既要为有需要者提供保障，又要维持工作激励。本文提出一种新颖的显示性偏好方法，用以识别DI福利的保险价值。研究表明，通过比较DI参保率对福利变化与工资变化的反应差异，即可识别其保险价值。在加拿大应用该框架后，我们估算出：每增加1美元DI福利，会产生0.60美元的额外抑制成本，但能创造2.20美元的保险价值。因此，我们的方法表明，在加拿大背景下，DI福利并未过度慷慨。

title: Southern roots abroad: The long-run impact of the Confederate migration to Brazil
title_zh: 海外南方根源：美国邦联移民巴西的长期影响
title_primary: 海外南方根源：美国邦联移民巴西的长期影响
title_secondary: Southern roots abroad: The long-run impact of the Confederate migration to Brazil
authors: João Tampellini
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines the long-term economic and cultural impacts of the postbellum migration of Southern white individuals to Brazil. Following the U.S. Civil War, thousands of individuals from the former Confederacy settled in a relatively poor region of São Paulo, contributing to its transformation into one of Brazil's wealthiest areas. I show that these migrants, though a small group, played a significant role in regional industrialization, particularly in cotton and textile industries, and in the mechanization of agriculture. Some of the migrants' cultural traits, such as Protestantism and English language use, persisted over time, largely due to the physical infrastructure they established. Unlike similar migrations within the U.S., I find no evidence of persistent legacies in terms of politics or racial inequality, emphasizing the role of local infrastructure in shaping the economic and cultural outcomes of immigration.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国内战后南方白人移民巴西的长期经济与文化影响。美国内战结束后，数千名前邦联成员定居于圣保罗一个相对贫困的地区，为该地区转变为巴西最富裕区域之一做出了贡献。我证明，这些移民虽人数不多，却在区域工业化中发挥了重要作用，尤其是在棉花和纺织产业以及农业机械化方面。移民的部分文化特征，如新教信仰和英语使用，随时间持续存在，这主要归功于他们所建立的有形基础设施。与美国境内类似迁移不同，我未发现政治或种族不平等方面的持久遗留影响，这强调了地方基础设施在塑造移民经济与文化成果中的关键作用。

title: Global Pension Asset Allocations and Debt Markets
title_zh: 全球养老金资产配置与债务市场
title_primary: 全球养老金资产配置与债务市场
title_secondary: Global Pension Asset Allocations and Debt Markets
authors: Karen K. Lewis, Xiang FANG, Bryan Hardy
official: 官方在线 2026-07-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The pension sector is an important investor group in global financial markets and a key holder of government and corporate debt. This article examines the evolution of pension fund asset allocations around the globe and documents two important structural changes. First, pension investors have shifted portfolio share allocations away from fixed income securities. This trend is robust across Defined Contribution (DC) and Defined Benefit (DB) programs as well as country groups. Second, pensions have instead shifted allocations into riskier investments within mutual funds as well as alternative investments. We hypothesize that a global decline in interest rates is one potential driver of this change. Using a global sample, we show that declining local currency government bond yields are associated with lower bond pension portfolio shares and higher holdings shares of mutual funds and foreign assets. We discuss the potential implications of these trends for borrowing costs. The declining holding share of pensions as a long-term investor group implies financing costs are less sensitive to new debt issues, but more sensitive to global uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 养老金部门是全球金融市场中的重要投资者群体，也是政府和公司债务的主要持有者。本文研究了全球范围内养老基金资产配置的演变，并记录了两个重要的结构性变化。首先，养老金投资者已将投资组合份额从固定收益证券中转移出来。这一趋势在固定缴款（DC）和固定收益（DB）计划以及不同国家组中均表现稳健。其次，养老金转而将资金配置到共同基金中风险更高的投资以及另类投资中。我们假设全球利率下降是这一变化的潜在驱动因素之一。利用全球样本，我们表明本币政府债券收益率的下降与养老金投资组合中债券份额的降低以及共同基金和外国资产持有份额的增加相关。我们讨论了这些趋势对借贷成本的潜在影响。作为长期投资者群体，养老金持有份额的下降意味着融资成本对新债务发行的敏感度降低，但对全球不确定性的敏感度增加。

title: Compliance, environmental regulation, and quota markets
title_zh: 合规、环境规制与配额市场
title_primary: 合规、环境规制与配额市场
title_secondary: Compliance, environmental regulation, and quota markets
authors: Florian Diekert, Yuanhao Li, Linda Nøstbakken, Andries Richter
source: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
official: 来源期次 2026-06-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Market-based instruments are widely promoted for their efficiency in achieving environmental goals, but their effectiveness depends on enforcement and compliance, which are often imperfect. We develop a theoretical model in which agents face both technological standards and quota regulations, with the possibility of non-compliance with both at the risk of fines. Within this model, we investigate how intrinsic motivation to comply with different regulations affects investment behavior in quota markets. We find that a greater willingness to invest in quotas can result from either a strong intrinsic motivation to comply with quota regulations or a weak motivation to comply with technological standards. To test these predictions, we use survey data and incentivized economic experiments with Norwegian fishers. The empirical results confirm the theory predictions: Fishers who find technological violations less acceptable tend to invest less in quotas, while those who disapprove of quota violations tend to buy more quotas. These findings highlight the critical role of compliance attitudes for quota market behavior and offer insights for designing more efficient environmental regulations.
abstract_zh: 基于市场的工具因其在实现环境目标方面的效率而被广泛推广，但其有效性依赖于执行与合规，而这些往往并不完善。我们构建了一个理论模型，其中行为主体面临技术标准与配额规定，且两者均存在违规风险并可能遭受罚款。在此模型框架内，我们探讨了遵守不同规定的内在动机如何影响配额市场中的投资行为。研究发现，对配额投资的更大意愿可能源于对配额规定强烈的内在遵守动机，或是对技术标准遵守动机的薄弱。为验证这些预测，我们利用调查数据及与挪威渔民进行的激励性经济实验。实证结果证实了理论预测：认为技术违规较不可接受的渔民倾向于减少配额投资，而不赞同配额违规的渔民则倾向于购买更多配额。这些发现凸显了合规态度对配额市场行为的关键作用，并为设计更高效的环境规制提供了洞见。

title: Game-Theoretic Modeling of Heterogeneous Investor Interactions for Stock Price Forecasting
title_zh: 异质投资者互动的博弈论建模及其在股价预测中的应用
title_primary: 异质投资者互动的博弈论建模及其在股价预测中的应用
title_secondary: Game-Theoretic Modeling of Heterogeneous Investor Interactions for Stock Price Forecasting
authors: Yong Zhang, Xinxiao Wu, Yunde Jia, Che Sun
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Accurate stock price forecasting has consistently remained a pivotal yet challenging FinTech task that underpins quantitative trading and investment decision making. Recent efforts have been dedicated to modeling various complex relationships among stocks in the stock market toward more reliable stock price forecasting.These methods depend heavily on strong static prior assumptions by modeling either temporal dependencies within individual stocks or spatial dependencies across different stocks based on predefined structures, while the complex market dynamics that drive stock price movements remain unexplored. To alleviate this issue, we propose a novel game-theoretic modeling method that captures heterogeneous investor interactions for stock price forecasting. The core idea is to embed game-theoretic mechanisms into the heterogeneous graph structure to finely model the dynamic strategic interactions among heterogeneous investors with respect to target stocks. Additionally, temporal positional encoding is adopted to reflect the differentiated influences of each game event at different time steps within the time window on future stock price movements. Leveraging heterogeneous graph networks, we proxy the intricate dynamics of the stock market through investor games and enable real-time information propagation and node updates among all nodes. Extensive experiments conducted on two real-world benchmark dataset demonstrate that our method effectively outperforms state-of-the-art stock price forecasting methods.
abstract_zh: 准确的股票价格预测一直是支撑量化交易与投资决策的关键且具有挑战性的金融科技任务。近期研究致力于建模股票市场中各类复杂关系，以实现更可靠的股价预测。这些方法高度依赖强静态先验假设，要么基于预定义结构建模单只股票的时间依赖性，要么建模不同股票间的空间依赖性，但驱动股价波动的复杂市场动态仍未被充分探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出一种新颖的博弈论建模方法，通过捕捉异质投资者互动来实现股价预测。其核心思想是将博弈论机制嵌入异质图结构，精细建模目标股票相关异质投资者间的动态策略互动。此外，采用时间位置编码来反映时间窗口内不同时间步的博弈事件对未来股价波动的差异化影响。借助异质图网络，我们通过投资者博弈代理股票市场的复杂动态，实现所有节点间的实时信息传播与节点更新。在两个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法有效超越了现有最优的股价预测方法。

title: Tax Evasion and the Contribution-Benefit Link: The Case of Parental Benefits in Hungary and Latvia
title_zh: 逃税与缴费-受益关联：匈牙利和拉脱维亚育儿福利案例研究
title_primary: 逃税与缴费-受益关联：匈牙利和拉脱维亚育儿福利案例研究
title_secondary: Tax Evasion and the Contribution-Benefit Link: The Case of Parental Benefits in Hungary and Latvia
authors: Bíró, Anikó, Elek, Péter, Jascisens, Vitalijs, Prinz, Dániel, Sándor, László 等
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies the interaction of the contribution-benefit link with tax evasion in the context of parental benefits in Hungary and Latvia. Across the two countries, institutional settings, and time periods, earnings and employment patterns suggest substantial pre-pregnancy underreporting, followed by partial formalization during pregnancy to increase benefits. Using policy reforms, the paper shows that the reporting response tracks changing incentives. The results indicate that even with third-party reporting, income underreporting can be common. Linking benefits to contributions when earnings are underreported may reduce evasion temporarily but can impose net fiscal costs depending on program design.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了匈牙利和拉脱维亚育儿福利背景下，缴费-福利关联与逃税行为的相互作用。在两国的制度环境与时间跨度中，收入与就业模式显示，孕前存在大量低报收入现象，而孕期则出现部分正规化以增加福利。通过政策改革分析，本文证明申报行为随激励变化而调整。结果表明，即便存在第三方报告机制，收入低报仍可能普遍存在。当收入被低报时，将福利与缴费挂钩虽能暂时减少逃税，但根据项目设计不同，可能产生净财政成本。

title: Is ride-sharing good for environment? Evidence from combining satellite and survey data on U.S. cities
title_zh: 拼车对环境有益吗？基于美国城市卫星与调查数据的证据
title_primary: 拼车对环境有益吗？基于美国城市卫星与调查数据的证据
title_secondary: Is ride-sharing good for environment? Evidence from combining satellite and survey data on U.S. cities
authors: Yoshifumi Konishi, Akari Ono
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We estimate the causal effect of ride-hailing entry on transport-related air pollution, disentangling its mediating effect through changes in commuting modes in U.S. cities. To do so, we combine two sets of empirical approaches. First, for our main outcome regression, we leverage granular satellite-based NO2 concentration data and a newly constructed Google Trends-based measure of ride-hailing presence, with the staggered difference-in-differences design. Second, to explore its mediating mechanism, we use household-level commuting mode data to run two auxiliary regressions: commuting modes on ride-hailing entry and ambient NO2 concentration on commuting modes. For identification on the latter, we construct our instruments by combining geography-based instruments with leave-one-out regional average exposure to Uber’s official entry. We find robust evidence that (i) ride-hailing improves air quality in highly dense cities, but has no significant impact in cities with low to medium density and (ii) this air quality improvement is indeed mediated by the associated changes in commuting mode choices. Our findings provide strong empirical support for the hypothesis that the environmental impact of ride-hailing depends on its complementarity with public transit.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了网约车进入对交通相关空气污染的因果效应，并分解了其通过美国城市通勤方式变化产生的中介效应。为此，我们结合了两套实证方法。首先，对于主要结果回归，我们利用基于卫星的高分辨率二氧化氮浓度数据和新构建的基于谷歌趋势的网约车存在度指标，采用交错双重差分设计。其次，为探究其中介机制，我们使用家庭层面的通勤方式数据进行了两项辅助回归：通勤方式对网约车进入的回归，以及环境二氧化氮浓度对通勤方式的回归。为识别后者，我们通过结合基于地理的工具变量与留一法区域平均优步官方进入暴露度来构建工具变量。我们发现了稳健的证据表明：（i）网约车改善了高密度城市的空气质量，但对低至中等密度城市无显著影响；（ii）这种空气质量改善确实由相关的通勤方式选择变化所中介。我们的发现为以下假设提供了强有力的实证支持：网约车的环境影响取决于其与公共交通的互补性。

abstract: 商事制度改革是经济增长的动力来源，也是推动市场高质量发展的重要手段。基于全国工商注册企业数据和全国税收调查数据，本文从企业简易注销改革这一退出侧视角出发，考察商事制度改革对激发企业市场活力的作用。研究发现，简易注销改革有助于企业以注销途径主动退出市场，激励企业首次进入和退出再进入，带来更多创业活动，并引致市场主体的净增加。进一步看，注销退出企业能有效释放公共资源，推动债权债务清算，信贷再配置后有效...

title: Input Sourcing under Climate Risk: Evidence from U.S. Manufacturing Firms
title_zh: 气候风险下的投入品采购：来自美国制造业企业的证据
title_primary: 气候风险下的投入品采购：来自美国制造业企业的证据
title_secondary: Input Sourcing under Climate Risk: Evidence from U.S. Manufacturing Firms
authors: Joaquin Blaum, Federico Esposito, Sebastian Heise
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the effect of risk on how firms organize their supply chains. We use transaction-level data on U.S. manufacturing imports to construct a novel measure of input sourcing risk based on the historical volatility of ocean shipping times. Our measure isolates the unexpected component of shipping times that is induced by weather conditions along more than 331,000 maritime routes. We first document that unexpected shipping delays significantly reduce importers’ sales, profits, and employment. We then show that firms actively diversify weather risk by using more routes and foreign suppliers, although their import values decline. To rationalize these findings, we introduce shipping time risk into a general equilibrium model of importing with firm heterogeneity. Our quantitative analysis predicts substantial costs for the U.S. economy associated with supply chain risk.
abstract_zh: 本文研究风险如何影响企业供应链组织方式。我们利用美国制造业进口的交易层面数据，基于海运时间的历史波动性构建了投入品采购风险的新测度指标。该指标通过分析超过33.1万条海运航线的天气条件，分离出运输时间中由天气因素引发的意外波动。首先，我们证实运输时间的意外延迟会显著降低进口商的销售额、利润和就业水平。其次，我们发现企业会通过增加航线数量和海外供应商来主动分散天气风险，尽管其进口总额有所下降。为解释这些发现，我们将运输时间风险引入具有企业异质性的进口一般均衡模型。定量分析预测，供应链风险将给美国经济带来巨大成本。

title: From digital finance to green growth: the role of FinTech in sustainable manufacturing
title_zh: 从数字金融到绿色增长：金融科技在可持续制造业中的作用
title_primary: 从数字金融到绿色增长：金融科技在可持续制造业中的作用
title_secondary: From digital finance to green growth: the role of FinTech in sustainable manufacturing
authors: Ya Bu, Xinze Du, Hui Li
official: 官方在线 2025-09-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: FinTech harnesses emerging technologies to drive corporate innovation, playing a crucial role in promoting green technological advancement and serving as a key pathway towards global sustainable development. This study employs a multi-sector technological progress model to examine firms’ R&D activities and interactions with financial institutions, investigating the impact and mechanisms of FinTech on green technological innovation. An empirical analysis is conducted using the Double Machine Learning (DML) approach, which addresses the curse of dimensionality and mitigates multicollinearity in high-dimensional data. The findings reveal that FinTech significantly enhances manufacturing enterprises’ preference for green technological innovation, a conclusion that remains robust across various sensitivity tests. Additionally, FinTech fosters green innovation by alleviating financing constraints, increasing internal R&D investment, and expanding the number of R&D personnel. Furthermore, corporate environmental information disclosure and alignment with government policies positively moderate this process, amplifying FinTech’s role in driving green technological progress. These findings provide scientific empirical evidence and policy insights to optimize the effectiveness of FinTech in promoting green innovation in manufacturing enterprises, contributing to the realization of national sustainable development goals.
abstract_zh: 金融科技利用新兴技术驱动企业创新，在推动绿色技术进步中发挥关键作用，是实现全球可持续发展的重要路径。本研究采用多部门技术进步模型，考察企业的研发活动及其与金融机构的互动，探究金融科技对绿色技术创新的影响及作用机制。通过双机器学习方法进行实证分析，该方法能够应对高维数据中的维度灾难问题并缓解多重共线性。研究结果表明，金融科技显著提升了制造业企业对绿色技术创新的偏好，这一结论在多种敏感性检验中依然稳健。此外，金融科技通过缓解融资约束、增加内部研发投入以及扩大研发人员规模来促进绿色创新。进一步地，企业环境信息披露水平以及与政府政策的契合度正向调节这一过程，增强了金融科技推动绿色技术进步的作用。这些发现为优化金融科技促进制造业企业绿色创新的有效性提供了科学实证依据和政策启示，有助于实现国家可持续发展目标。
